targets.rawSql: SELECT cohort_date AS Cohort, maxIf(retention_percent, day_number = 0) AS `Day 0`, maxIf(retention_percent, day_number = 1) AS `Day 1`, maxIf(retention_percent, day_number = 2) AS `Day 2`, maxIf(retention_percent, day_number = 3) AS `Day 3`, maxIf(retention_percent, day_number = 4) AS `Day 4`, maxIf(retention_percent, day_number = 5) AS `Day 5`, maxIf(retention_percent, day_number = 6) AS `Day 6`, maxIf(retention_percent, day_number = 7) AS `Day 7` FROM analytics.cohort_retention FINAL GROUP BY cohort_date ORDER BY cohort_date DESC
SELECT toDateTime(date) AS time, value AS dau FROM analytics.daily_metrics FINAL WHERE metric_name = 'dau' ORDER BY date
SELECT toDateTime(date) AS time, value AS conversion FROM analytics.daily_metrics FINAL WHERE metric_name = 'view_conversion' ORDER BY date
